get.description: Returns your own fills, newest first; the counterparty is never included. Requires an active API key.

parameters.name: instrument_id
parameters.description: Filter by instrument ID. May appear only once; a repeat returns 400 INVALID_FIELD.

parameters.description: Filter by order ID, as a positive decimal string up to 9223372036854775807. Completed orders match too; only your side of the trade is returned. May appear only once; a repeat returns 400 INVALID_FIELD.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of trades per page. Default 100; must be 1 to 500, otherwise 400. Pages count trades, so both sides of a self-match stay on one page and a page can hold more fills than limit. May appear only once; a repeat returns 400 INVALID_FIELD.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's cursor field. Omit on the first request. May appear only once; a repeat returns 400 INVALID_FIELD.

ticker.description: Unique instrument ticker. Treat it as an opaque identifier.

series_ticker.description: Ticker of the series this instrument belongs to.

event_ticker.description: Ticker of the event this instrument belongs to.

group_ticker.description: Ticker of the group of instruments that share this series and event.

proposition.description: Plain-language criteria for the YES outcome.

disclaimers.description: Compliance or eligibility disclaimer, or null when there is none.
disclaimers.example: Professional football players may not trade this instrument.

contract_size.description: USDC notional per contract, as a decimal string. Its numeric value is 1.

price_level_structure.description: Tick-size schedule for order prices: LINEAR_CENT, DECI_CENT, or TAPERED_DECI_CENT.

fractional_enabled.description: Whether fractional contract quantities are enabled.

min_order_size.description: Minimum order quantity in contracts, as a decimal string.

position_limit_per_instrument.description: Maximum position in contracts that a firm may hold in this instrument, as a decimal string.

speedbump_ms.description: Speed-bump delay applied to aggressive orders, in milliseconds, as a decimal string. Null or 0 means no speed bump.

status.description: Lifecycle status: LISTED, OPEN, PAUSE, CLOSED, DETERMINED, SETTLED, AMENDED, or DELISTED. Orders are accepted only while OPEN.

list_time.description: Time of the first transition to LISTED, in Unix epoch milliseconds. Null until listed.

open_time.description: Time of the first transition to OPEN, in Unix epoch milliseconds. Null until opened.

close_time.description: Time of the most recent transition to CLOSED, in Unix epoch milliseconds. Null until closed.

expected_open_time.description: Estimated open time for display, in Unix epoch milliseconds, or null. Non-binding: trading opens only when status becomes OPEN.

expected_close_time.description: Estimated close time for display, in Unix epoch milliseconds, or null. Non-binding: trading closes only when status becomes CLOSED.

settlement_outcome.description: Determined outcome: YES, NO, or SCALAR. Null before the instrument is determined.

settlement_value.description: Payout per contract in USDC, from 0 through 1, as a decimal string. Null before the instrument is determined.

settlement_time.description: Time of the transition to SETTLED, in Unix epoch milliseconds. Null until settled.

open_interest.description: Current open interest in contracts, as a decimal string. Null when the instrument has never traded.

total_volume.description: Total traded volume in contracts, as a decimal string. Null when the instrument has never traded.

updated_time.description: Time of the instrument's latest change, in Unix epoch milliseconds. The updated_time filters compare this value.

additional_metadata.description: Market-specific instrument metadata as a JSON object. The fields vary by market.

num_orders_canceled.description: Number of active orders canceled. Always 0 for an unlock.

error.description: Machine-readable error code, for example INVALID_FIELD, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, or UNAUTHORIZED.

instrument_id.description: Id of the instrument to trade, as a canonical decimal string. Tickers and JSON numbers are rejected.

firm_id.description: Id of the firm the order is for, as a canonical decimal string. Required for FCM-level API keys, and must be a firm under your FCM. A FIRM-level key may omit it or send its own firm id.

side.description: Order side. BUY and SELL trade the YES contract. BUY_NO and SELL_NO trade the NO side and are booked as SELL or BUY of YES at one minus the price. BUY_NO and SELL_NO are REST only: FIX order entry accepts only Buy and Sell, so FIX clients convert NO orders themselves (BUY_NO at price P is SELL at 1 minus P).

price.description: Limit price per contract in USDC, as a decimal string strictly between 0 and 1 that aligns to the instrument's tick size. Omit or send null for a market order. For BUY_NO and SELL_NO it is the NO price and is required.

quantity.description: Number of contracts to trade, as a positive decimal string.

time_in_force.description: How long the order stays active: GTC rests until filled or canceled, IOC fills what it can immediately and cancels the rest, FOK fills completely at once or is rejected. Market orders run as IOC unless you send FOK.

client_order_id.description: Your identifier for the order: at most 18 printable ASCII characters, or a 36-character lowercase UUID. Must be unique among your active orders.

sub_account.description: Sub-account the order and any resulting position belong to, in the same format as client_order_id. A new sub-account is created on first use.

post_only.description: If true, the order only adds liquidity. An order that would cross the book rests at the best non-crossing price instead, unless post_only_reject is true. Not allowed on market orders.

post_only_reject.description: If true, the order only adds liquidity and is rejected with POST_ONLY_WOULD_CROSS if it would cross the book. Not allowed on market orders.

self_match_prevention_id.description: Optional positive self-match prevention id. An incoming order does not match a resting order that carries the same id; self_match_prevention_mode decides which order is canceled.

self_match_prevention_mode.description: Which order to cancel when self-match prevention triggers: CANCEL_AGGRESSING, CANCEL_RESTING, or CANCEL_BOTH. When omitted, your user or firm default applies.

order_id.description: Exchange-assigned order id, as a canonical decimal string.

status.description: Order state when the response was sent: SUBMITTED (resting with no fills), PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, or CANCELED (nothing filled and the order was canceled, as with an unfilled IOC order).

instrument_id.description: Instrument id, as a canonical decimal string.

side.description: Side as booked: BUY or SELL of the YES contract. BUY_NO and SELL_NO orders appear here as SELL and BUY.

original_side.description: Side as you submitted it, including BUY_NO or SELL_NO.

price.description: Limit price of the YES order as booked, in USDC, as a decimal string. For BUY_NO and SELL_NO it is one minus the price you sent. Null for a market order.

quantity.description: Order quantity in contracts, as a decimal string.

filled_quantity.description: Quantity filled by the time of the response, in contracts, as a decimal string.

remaining_quantity.description: Quantity not filled by the time of the response, in contracts, as a decimal string.

client_order_id.description: Echo of the client order id from the request.

sub_account.description: Echo of the sub-account from the request.

fills.description: Fills that executed before the response was sent, or null if there were none.

reject_reason.description: Always null. A rejected order returns an error response instead of this object.
